cited.quote: Thiruvallur District at a revised estimated cost of Rs.380 crore is nearing completion.

rationale: The promise says 'this reservoir' without naming it, so no extract can be tied to it. C1 mentions a reservoir scheme nearing completion, but nothing links it to this commitment; the other extracts cover desilting, check dams and building rules.

cited.quote: L.A. Bill No.7 of 2017 – Tamil Nadu Admission to MBBS and BDS courses Act, 2017
were unanimously passed in the floor of Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly

rationale: C1 and C4 show the state formally opposed NEET through two bills passed unanimously in the Assembly in 2017 and sent to the Union for assent, plus legal action. C1 states the government will continue to oppose NEET. Formal state steps on the same issue were taken. Only the year is given.

cited.quote: will be distributed 4 Goats / Sheep each during 2016-17
Free Distribution of Sheep/Goat to the persons living below poverty line

rationale: C1 is the 2016-09-16 GO sanctioning the 2016-17 free goat/sheep scheme, 4 animals per beneficiary. C2 is the 2020-21 sanction (head of account for persons below the poverty line), and C5 the 2019-20 sanction, showing yearly continuation.

No extract concerns an elevated highway from Meenambakkam to Chengalpattu. C1/C2 are about a road over bridge in Chengalpattu Division at a different location, C3/C4 an elevated corridor in Erode, C5 elevated works in Coimbatore and Erode.

cited.quote: I urge the Government of India to consider this request and enable the use of Tamil language
the Government of India have been addressed again to reconsider the request of this State

rationale: C1, the Governor's address in the Assembly on 2017-01-23, formally urges the Union to make Tamil an official language of the Union and enable its use in the Madras High Court. C2 confirms the Government of India was addressed again. Urging is the promise, so this formal step realises it.

cited.quote: The Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly has unanimously passed a Resolution on 1-8-2016 to call upon the Government

rationale: The only Assembly resolution in the extracts (C1, 1-8-2016) concerns renaming the High Court of Madras, not Tamil as an official or High Court language. C1's Governor's address urges the Union on Tamil but is not a resolution. C2-C5 are unrelated.
No extract is about barring genetically modified crops. C1 only lists GM seeds as a law syllabus topic; C2, C3 and C5 are seed, cashew and oilseed scheme sanctions; C4 is crop insurance.

cited.quote: Implementation of State Fodder Development Scheme during the year 2019-20 for augmenting fodder production across the State
the Government is implementing State Fodder Development Scheme since 2011-12 for which a sum of Rs.215 crore

rationale: C1 is the GO of 2019-09-05 sanctioning Rs.25 crore for the State Fodder Development Scheme in 2019-20; C4 reports the scheme continuing. The earlier policy notes (C3, C5) describe continuation but are not GOs, so the first GO shown is C1.

cited.quote: Steam Boilers for cooking hygienic food have been provided to 380 Adi Dravidar Welfare Hostels

rationale: C1-C3 policy notes report steam boilers for cooking in hostels, which is related but not named as steam idli cookers, and carries no GO or dated official step. C4 and C5 are hostel repair and construction GOs. Related activity only.

cited.quote: Construction of Additional Dormitory for Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Denotified Community Students at 10 places

rationale: 'These dormitories' is not identified. C1 reports additional dormitories for backward-class students at 10 places in a policy note and C4 mentions a construction workers' dormitory, but neither gives a GO or dated step for a further increase. C2, C3 and C5 are unrelated.

cited.quote: Formulating new Scheme Talent Hunting Camp by merging the Day Boarders Scheme and Week End Coaching Camp Scheme

rationale: C4 is a GO of 2016-10-25 from the sports department formulating a new Talent Hunting Camp scheme with sanction of funds to the Sports Development Authority, meeting the indicator of an order for sports development measures. C1-C3 are policy notes.

cited.quote: Sports Development Authority of Tamil Nadu - conducting Tamil Nadu All India Service and Central Services Officers Tournament
Establishment of e-Library in the Tamil nadu Pysical Education and Sports University Campus

rationale: C5 is a GO of 2019-11-22 sanctioning a new officers' sports tournament for three years, a new sports programme. C4 (2016-09-22) sanctions a new e-library at the sports university, which is academic infrastructure rather than a sports scheme, so the date follows C5. Scope is modest.

cited.quote: sanctioned 500 Nos. of Solar powered pumping systems upto capacity of 10 HP to the farmers with 80% subsidy
Provision of 500 Nos. of Solar Pumps with 90 percent subsidy for the year 2018-2019

rationale: C1 (GO of 2017-08-31) recalls the 2016-17 sanction of pumps up to 10 HP at 80% subsidy and sanctions 1000 more at 90% for 5-10 HP. C3 sanctions 500 more at 90% in 2018-19. The subsidy was continued at or above 80%. The 2016-17 sanction itself has no exact date.

cited.quote: Construction of 26.49 lakh IHHLs under Swachh Bharat Mission(Gramin) and Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme

rationale: C1 is the GO of 2017-11-24 approving guidelines for constructing 26.49 lakh individual household latrines for households without toilets, following a Chief Minister announcement. C2 repeats the same GO. C3-C5 report coverage reaching about 98-100%.

cited.quote: resurvey was conducted in 2018 to identify the households without toilets that are left out

rationale: C5, a GO of 2020-01-06, states that a resurvey was conducted in 2018 to identify households without toilets left out of the 2013 baseline survey. Only the year is given. C3 (GO 2017) covers master register updating, a related step.

cited.quote: the Government issue orders sanctioning an additional fund of Rs.4,39,93,920
Old Age Pension Scheme had been introduced in the year 1962 and since then continuously it is being implemented

rationale: C2 states the old-age pension scheme continues, at Rs.1,000 per month. C4 is a GO of 2018-10-31 sanctioning extra funds for old-age pension disbursement to pensioners aged 80 and above. This is the earliest GO among the extracts.

The promise does not say which scheme is to be expanded, so no extract can be tied to it. The extracts cover coffee growers, house building advance, dryland clusters, house repair and horticulture schemes, none identified as the one meant.

No extract mentions allocating 20 percent of SIDCO industrial plots to Adi Dravidars and Tribals. C1-C4 are general welfare, TAHDCO and staffing documents; C5 is a SIDCO work-shed construction GO with no reservation.

cited.quote: to organise 2041 new Milk Producers Cooperative Societies in lieu of dormant societies
action will be taken to form Primary Milk Producers Co-operative Societies for the beneficiaries in these villages

rationale: C1 is an undated policy note saying efforts are being taken to organise new societies, and C4 only says societies will be formed after cow distribution. Neither shows a GO or registration of new societies. C5 funds buildings for existing societies.

cited.quote: Government of Tamil Nadu has enacted Tamil Nadu Sugarcane (Regulation of Purchase Price) Act 2018
hereby sanction a sum of Rs.106.00 Crore (Rupees One Hundred and Six Crore only) towards actual transport cost

rationale: C3 reports the 2018 Act enacted so farmers get Fair and Remunerative Price in time, and incentives disbursed to farmers. C2 (GO of 2020-04-03) sanctions Rs.106 crore to mills on condition it clears farmers' FRP arrears. State action was taken, though arrears persisted. The Act is dated by year only.
